evidence: M-O s.v. card suit, from Vives 1540
terms.comment: Vives’s word: the cards are divided in quattuor genera seu familiās.
Traupman’s word, as in French couleur; a trump suit is color praelātus.

phrases.latin: chartae enim Hispānicae, quem ad modum et Gallicae, in quattuor sunt genera seu familiās dīvīsae
phrases.english: for Spanish cards, like French ones, are divided into four kinds or suits
phrases.source: Vives, Exercitātiō (1540) p. 380, quoted by Morgan–Owens s.v. card suit

sources: Lewis & Short: familia · Lewis & Short: color
